name: timer
description: Minimalist interval timer + habit tracker (web clone of Interval Timer) with progress tracking, deployed at timer.musel.dev

scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix client ci
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:deploy && npm run build
